name: China Coal Xinji Energy Co.,Ltd
summary: China Coal Xinji Energy Co., Ltd. specializes in the extraction, processing, and commercialization of both bituminous and anthracite coal. Beyond its core mining ventures, the company's activities extend to thermal power generation, hospitality services (including hotels and catering), property administration, and the supply of electricity and heating. Headquartered in Huainan, China, the entity was previously named SDIC Xinji Energy Co., Ltd., adopting its current moniker in January 2017.
